body:
The error is also emitted when looking at a specific index (`def [](..)`). I think those are the only two places where you would try to access something beyond the limit.

We can't perform the bounds check in initialize because we do not know a priori which positions will become part of the proof. For example, the HPM_EVENTS param could technically have 2^64 elements. That's not a problem as long as you don't have a proof that tries to specifically look at a position > 64 (say, by checking for equality with a 65-entry array).
